name: Rules
about: The Operations Manager's RULES block: how many of the office's agents hold a rule read into their job; its RUN counts the reviews LEGIT, STUPID and not reviewed.
reads: the Operations Manager office's own store (~/larryd/server/runtime/internal/instance/data/operations_manager)
the office's cards, jobs and logs in LARRYD under SYSTEM, through the platform's pipeline (wid core_engine)
the platform files the office reads (settings reads: themes, templates, engine.json, manifest.json, global_config)

card.pitch: Every agent's rules, read and reviewed blind. Red while a review says STUPID.
